description: Get upcoming (or a specific title's) episode air times, soonest-airing first (confirmed live) — or, with `notYetAired: false`, already-aired ones newest first. Omit `mediaId` for the site-wide upcoming schedule, or pass it (from search_media/get_media) to get one title's next-episode air time. Set `airingAfter`/`airingBefore` for a date window instead (e.g. what airs this week, or what aired yesterday). Anime only — manga has no airing schedule; a manga id (like any non-anime id) is rejected as not-found rather than silently returning an empty schedule, though that error reads the same as a nonexistent id and doesn't single out the manga/anime mismatch.

airingAfter.description: Only episodes airing after this instant — ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. "2026-10-20T00:00:00Z" or "2026-10-20T09:00:00+09:00".

airingBefore.description: Only episodes airing before this instant (same format as `airingAfter`). Pair the two for a window, e.g. this week's episodes.

mediaId.description: Restrict to this AniList anime ID (not manga).

notYetAired.description: true: only not-yet-aired episodes; false: only already-aired ones (confirmed live: false swaps to a past-only result set, it doesn't add past episodes to the upcoming ones). Omitted, it defaults to true — unless `airingAfter`/`airingBefore` is set, in which case the window alone decides, so a window spanning now returns both aired and upcoming episodes.

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 50, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

name: get_anime_schedule
title: Get the anime airing schedule
